description: Cross-platform RDLC report engine for .NET 8, 9, 10 and .NET Framework 4.7.2/4.8. Drop-in replacement for Microsoft SSRS ReportViewer — generate PDF, Excel, Word, HTML from existing .rdlc files on Linux, macOS, Docker, Kubernetes without GDI+ or libgdiplus. Self-hosted alternative to Power BI Paginated Reports.
releaseNotes: 1.7.0: reports wired into applications, and edited by agents. LocalReport.SaveRowsForDesigner writes the rows an application gives a report for the designer to preview with; LocalReport.CheckDataSources says a missing data source, a field the rows lack or of another type; ReportEditor.BindDataSet makes a dataset's fields a row type's properties, ReportEditor.AppCode the code that renders the report from an application. ReportEditor's operations, tried by AI agents building real reports: a Swiss QR-bill's payment part as SIX lays it out (qrbill, at the page's foot, the paper's width), items kept together on one page (keepWith), lists of cards, trees, colour scales, page columns, group totals and counts, barcode columns, and help as an index. CheckRendering also says blank pages, items a growing matrix pushes off the page and text a box cuts. Word: a flowing document's boxes side by side are one table, not tables in tables; lists of cards as paragraphs; document map headings as Word's headings. System.Uri in expressions on .NET 8+. Details: https://ssrs2.net
